manifest.name: dsh-workbuddy-kit
manifest.description: Let DeepSeek Harness drive a local Tencent WorkBuddy agent: dispatch a bounded task, wait for a terminal state, read the evidence, archive the exact session.

bundle.text:
# dsh-workbuddy-kit bundle layer.
#
# One insertion only: this bundle adds its own row and replaces no Harness
# product row, no provider, and no sandbox/permission configuration.
#
# The row registers native DSH tools (wb_*) on ctx.tools. It starts no process
# and touches no WorkBuddy state until a tool is actually called.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-workbuddy-kit
      name: 'dsh-workbuddy-kit'

readme.text:
[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

[](LICENSE) [](https://nodejs.org) [](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)

> **DeepSeek Harness 负责想清楚并验收，本机 WorkBuddy 负责动手做：一次派发、等到终态、自己复核证据、按完整 sessionId 归档。**

一个本机工具包，把「DSH 派活」和「WorkBuddy 干活」接成闭环。两个前门共用同一张工具表：

- **原生 DSH 工具**（Cordis 插件 `dsh-workbuddy-kit`，注册 `wb_*` 到 `ctx.tools`）
- **stdio MCP 服务**（`dsh-workbuddy-mcp`，任何 MCP 客户端可用）

两者行为完全一致，因为它们调用的是同一份 `src/tools.mjs`。

readme.section: 这是插件、技能，还是 MCP 服务？
readme.text:
| 形态 | 文件 | 怎么装 | 作用 | 改完要重启吗 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **DSH 插件**（主体） | plugin/index.mjs + cordis.patch.yml | dsh plugin --profile <profile> add . | 把 18 个 wb_* 注册进 ctx.tools，在 DSH 里直接调用 | **要**（工具表在启动时快照） |
| **技能**（附带，可选） | skills/delegate-to-workbuddy/SKILL.md | 拷到 <DSH_HOME>/agents-home/skills/ | 教 agent 何时派发、怎么等终态、怎么复核证据、怎么按 ID 归档 | 不要（热加载） |
| **MCP stdio 服务** | mcp/server.mjs | 写进任意 MCP 客户端配置 | 给非 DSH 的客户端（Claude / Codex / 自研）用同一套工具 | 不要 |
| **CLI** |  in/wb.mjs | 
ode bin/wb.mjs … 或 
pm i -g | 手工验证、脚本化，不接任何客户端 | 不要 |

readme.section: 这是插件、技能，还是 MCP 服务？
readme.text: **插件 = 能力（工具），技能 = 行为指南（什么时候用、按什么顺序用）。** 插件可以单独用；技能离开插件没有意义。只想要工具就装插件；想让 agent 自觉按「派发 → 等终态 → 复核 → 归档」的规矩办事，再叠加技能。

| 没有它的时候 | 有了它 |
| --- | --- |
| 想让 WorkBuddy 干活，只能把上下文、路径、要求手打一遍，还得自己盯着它跑完没有 | 一次派发拿到 `runId`，`wait_run` 拉到终态；`state` / `stopReason` / `toolCalls` / `workspaceChanges` 都是结构化字段，超时不算终态 |
| 「它说做完了」= 做完了？ | 工具返回的是**证据**：git 前后对比、工具调用数、完整转录、sha256 归档副本；调用方自己复核才算完 |
| 派出去的会话在桌面 App 里看不见，等于没发生过 | 默认自动登记进 App 索引，会话就出现在**同一个工作区**下（跟随 DSH 当前目录），点开就是完整对话 |
| 想批量盯桌面 App 的定时任务，只能一个个点开看 | 三个只读工具直接读 `workbuddy.db`：任务清单、每次运行、成功率与失败码、逾期任务 |
| 它的权限边界靠猜 | 实测过的矩阵写死在文档里：工作区内读写用 `acceptEdits`；跨目录读、`WebFetch`/`curl` 要 `bypassPermissions`；`WebSearch` 无头下不可用 |

本机 WorkBuddy 桌面版（腾讯，实测 `5.8.3`）在自己的安装目录里**自带一个 CodeBuddy agent CLI**：

```text
D:\Program Files\WorkBuddy\resources\app.asar.unpacked\cli\
  bin\codebuddy          # @genie/agent-cli 入口（实测 2.161.0）
  dist\codebuddy-lite-wb.mjs  # 当前发行只带 lite-wb 包
```

这个 CLI 支持无头运行：`-p/--print`、`--output-format stream-json`、`--session-id`、`--permission-mode`、`--model`、`--max-turns`、`--effort`、`--mcp-config`……本工具包就是把这条通道变成一组可验收的工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `wb_doctor` | 只读自检：CLI、Node、数据目录、版本、自定义模型、最近是否撞到登录墙 |
| `wb_list_capabilities` | 真实可用的 permission mode / 自定义模型 |
| `wb_list_projects` / `wb_list_sessions` | 找到 WorkBuddy 的工程目录与会话 |
| `wb_start_review` | **只读**派发（`--permission-mode plan`，并拒绝 Write/Edit/NotebookEdit） |
| `wb_start_run` | 实施派发（默认 `acceptEdits`） |
| `wb_wait_run` / `wb_get_run` | 盯到终态；超时**不算**终态（`hostMustCallWaitRunAgain`） |
| `wb_cancel_run` | 终止整个子进程树 |
| `wb_list_runs` | 本机派发台账 |
| `wb_read_session` | 直接读对话记录（消息、工具调用、模型），自己复核 |
| `wb_archive_session` | 按完整 sessionId 归档：带 SHA-256 的副本 + manifest + 索引 |
| `wb_list_automations` | **桌面 App 调度器**：定时任务清单（节奏/下次触发/最近结果/模型/权限/推送） |
| `wb_get_automation_runs` | 某个定时任务的运行历史、成功率、失败码 |
| `wb_automation_health` | 调度器体检：生效 vs 软删、总运行/失败率、失败码分布、过期未触发 |
调度器三个工具**只读** `workbuddy.db`（`automations` / `automation_runs` / `automation_runtime_state`），不写任何调度状态。

真实跑过一次的形态（这就是本仓库在制作机上的验收记录）：

```text
你   ❯ 用 WorkBuddy 只读核对 notes.md 里的标记，别改文件

DSH ❯ wb_start_review { workspace:"E:\\Code\\demo",
                        task:"读出形如 DWB-ACCEPT-XXXX 的标记，原样引用，不要修改任何文件" }

拿到的不是「已完成」四个字，而是：结论 + 工具调用次数 + 真实 sessionId + 归档摘要。
前置：本机已装 WorkBuddy 桌面版；Node ≥ 22.19（跑 DSH 用，本工具包自身零依赖）。

readme.section: A. 丢给 AI（推荐，零手工）
readme.text:
把下面这段原样发给任何有终端权限的 AI（DSH / Claude / Codex 都行）：

``text
请安装并验收 https://github.com/ksoulness/dsh-workbuddy-kit 这个 DSH 插件。

先读 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ksoulness/dsh-workbuddy-kit/main/AGENTS.md 并按它执行；读不到就按下面四步：

readme.section: A. 丢给 AI（推荐，零手工）
readme.text:
1. 前置检查：node -v 需 >= 22.19；git、dsh 可用；确认本机存在 WorkBuddy 的 CLI 目录
   （Windows: C:\Program Files\WorkBuddy\resources\app.asar.unpacked\cli\bin）。
2. 安装：git clone 仓库后 dsh plugin --profile <我的profile> add .，
   再用 dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config 确认出现 dsh-workbuddy-kit 行。
3. 验收：
pm test（应 pass 65 / fail 0）、
pm run verify（应 18 tools / 0 failures）、

ode bin/wb.mjs doctor（应 found true）。
4. 报告：用表格列出每一步的命令、真实输出、结论；最后告诉我是否需要重启 DSH。

readme.section: A. 丢给 AI（推荐，零手工）
readme.text:
铁律：不要提权、不要 sudo、不要写 workbuddy.db、不要改我的 models.json 和会话文件、
不要调用 wb_publish_session、不要在没有亲眼看到输出时声称成功。失败就贴原始报错。
``

装完记得**重启 DSH**（工具表在启动时快照）；技能是热加载的，改了立刻生效。

readme.section: B. 原生 DSH 工具（手工）
readme.text:
```sh
git clone <this repo> dsh-workbuddy-kit
cd dsh-workbuddy-kit
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -n workbuddy

重启 DSH（Web 端刷新页面）后，`wb_*` 就是原生工具。

readme.section: C. MCP stdio（任何 MCP 客户端）
readme.text:
`cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一行，不要在同一个 profile 同时开 A 和 B（工具名会重复）：

```yaml
- id: mcp-workbuddy
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: workbuddy

readme.section: D. 离线 tarball（不联网、不装 npm 包）
readme.text:
每次 Release 都附带 dsh-workbuddy-kit-<version>.tgz，内含  in/ mcp/ plugin/ src/ docs/ skills/ scripts/ LICENSE README*：

`sh
npm pack                                  # 或直接从 Release 下载
npm i -g ./dsh-workbuddy-kit-0.1.0.tgz    # 拿到 dwb / dsh-workbuddy-mcp 两个命令
dwb doctor
`

不装全局也行：解包后 
ode package/bin/wb.mjs doctor 就能用。

readme.section: E. 手工验证（不接任何客户端）
readme.text:
```sh
node bin/wb.mjs doctor
node bin/wb.mjs review --workspace E:\Code\demo --task "只读核对 README 第 1 节，给出精确行号" --wait 300
node bin/wb.mjs sessions --limit 5
```

readme.section: 关键约束（都是实测出来的，不是猜的）
readme.text:
- **CLI 必须指向 WorkBuddy 的数据目录**：不设 `CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR` / `WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR`，CLI 会去读 `~/.codebuddy`，那里没有登录态。本工具包自动指向 `~/.workbuddy`。
- **当前发行只带 `lite-wb` 包**：必须带 `CODEBUDDY_FORCE_LITE_WB_BUNDLE=1`，否则启动器会去找不存在的 `dist/codebuddy`。工具包自动判定。
- **无头 CLI 用不了桌面版的登录态**：账号默认模型会直接返回 `Authentication required`。工具包默认挑 `<configDir>/models.json` 里的第一个自定义模型（本机实测 `custom-local:cn:space-bunny` 可用），并把这个选择记在 `modelSource` 里；用 `DWB_DEFAULT_MODEL` 可覆盖。
- **无头下工具调用要 `-y`**：腾讯文档明确「`-y` 是非交互模式必需参数」，否则读写/命令会被拦（本仓库实测：`plan` 模式下 Bash 被拒，模型改走 Grep/Read）。`wb_start_run` 提供显式的 `skipPermissions: true`，从不默认打开；HIGH/CRITICAL 命令仍可能要求确认。
- **会话落在 `<configDir>/projects/<工程名>/<sessionId>.jsonl`**，工程名是工作目录的映射（`E:\Code\acme-app` → `e-Code-acme-app`）。归档就是对这个文件做带摘要的副本。
- **归档不动厂商数据**：默认 `copy`，WorkBuddy 自己的会话列表不变；`move` 是显式的可逆选项。

readme.section: 桌面 App 的调度器（定时任务）
readme.text:
定时任务**不在文件里**，在 `~/.workbuddy/workbuddy.db` 的三张表（`automations.db` 是 0 字节的遗留空文件）：

| 表 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `automations` | 任务定义：名字、完整 prompt、状态、`rrule`、`next_run_at`、`last_run_at`、模型、权限模式、工作区、推送渠道、`deleted_at` |
| `automation_runs` | 每次触发：`thread_id`、状态、`result_success`、`failure_code`、`reason_code`、标题 |
| `automation_runtime_state` | `running`、`last_error` |

readme.section: 桌面 App 的调度器（定时任务）
readme.text:
```sh
node bin/wb.mjs automations              # 生效中的任务
node bin/wb.mjs automations --all        # 含软删除
node bin/wb.mjs automations --prompt     # 附带 prompt 预览（默认不返回）
node bin/wb.mjs automation-runs --name "研究流水线监护" --limit 5 --failures

两个必须知道的坑（实测）：

- **软删除行 `status` 仍是 `ACTIVE`**：真正的活性信号是 `deleted_at`。本工具包输出 `softDeleted` 与 `live` 两个显式字段，避免把僵尸任务当活跃任务。
- **prompt 全文就在库里**（很长、很私人）：默认只返回 `promptBytes`，要预览得显式 `includePrompt: true`，且截断到 2000 字符。

readme.section: 桌面 App 的调度器（定时任务）
readme.text: 读法是 `readOnly: true` 打开 SQLite（WAL 读者不影响正在运行的桌面 App）。调度器**只读**：暂停/改 RRULE/新建/删除都要走桌面自己的 IPC 或 UI，直写会让界面与库不一致。

readme.section: 让派发的会话出现在桌面 App 里（写库，可撤销）
readme.text:
默认情况下 CLI 会话**不会**出现在桌面 App 的会话列表里：它只写 `projects/<slug>/<id>.jsonl`，不写 App 自己的索引。桌面列表的查询是：

```sql
SELECT … FROM sessions
 WHERE transport = 'local' AND deleted_at IS NULL
   AND (user_id = ? OR user_id = '')
   AND id IN (…)

所以转录再完整，**没有那一行 `sessions` 记录就是不可见**。补上那一行（外加一行 `session_usage`）就会出现：

```sh
node bin/wb.mjs publish --session <sessionId> --title "【DSH 派发】…"
node bin/wb.mjs published                          # 本工具包发布过哪些
node bin/wb.mjs unpublish --session <sessionId>    # 只删自己插的那两行
```

readme.section: 让派发的会话出现在桌面 App 里（写库，可撤销）
readme.text:
工具：`wb_publish_session` / `wb_unpublish_session` / `wb_list_published`。
`publish` 也接受 `--run <runId>`，直接从派发台账解析 sessionId。**默认就会发布**：派发跑完自动登记，结果记在运行的 `publishResult` 字段里，发布失败不会改写运行的终态。要**不**污染 App 列表就显式传 `publishToApp: false`（CLI 是 `--no-publish`），此时只写转录、不进 App。

readme.section: 让派发的会话出现在桌面 App 里（写库，可撤销）
readme.text:
> **工作区归属 = DSH 会话当前的工作目录**（不是写死的路径）。省略 `workspace` 时插件每次调用都会向 `workingDirectory` 服务要当前目录，所以你在 DSH 里 `cd` 到哪，WorkBuddy 就在哪开工；解析不到就报错，不会退回 harness 安装目录。`workspace` 只在你需要**故意**换目录时显式传。
>
> **工作区归属由 `workspace` 决定**：桌面 App 按会话的 `cwd` 分组，所以派发时把 `workspace` 设成你平时用 DSH 的那个目录（例如 `E:\Code\acme-app`），这个会话就会出现在同一个工作区下；换成别的目录，就会多出一个新工作区。`wb_start_run` / `wb_start_review` 现在 `workspace` 可省略，省略时用当前 DSH 会话的工作目录（插件注入 `workingDirectory` 服务）；解析不到时**直接报错**而不是退回 `process.cwd()`——那是 harness 安装目录，发到那里会让 App 多出一个垃圾工作区。

readme.section: 让派发的会话出现在桌面 App 里（写库，可撤销）
readme.text:
写什么：一行 `sessions`（`id`、`cwd` 归一成 `E:/Code/x`、`user_id` 取当前登录用户、`title`、`status`、`created_at`/`updated_at`/`last_activity_at`、`transport='local'`、`source_mode='craft'`、`mode='craft'`、`model`）+ 一行 `session_usage`（`size` = 转录字节数）。**转录文件一个字节都不改。**

安全边界：

readme.section: 让派发的会话出现在桌面 App 里（写库，可撤销）
readme.text:
- 会话不存在、读不到 `cwd`、或库里已有该 id → **拒绝**并说明原因；
- 每次插入记进 `<stateDir>/published.jsonl`；`unpublish` 只删账本里登记过的行，且不动其他会话行；
- 建议先备份库（`docs/setup.md` 有一条实测命令）；
- 手法不是本文独创：GitHub 上的 [`workbuddy-account-migrate`](https://github.com/xiaoliuzhuan666/workbuddy-account-migrate) 用同样方式（写 `sessions`/`session_usage` + 搬 `projects/<slug>/`）做跨账号会话复制，并明确写了「不写 sessions 行，客户端就找不到」。

| 项目 | 它做什么 | 与本仓库的区别 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`dsh-connect-workbuddy`](https://dsh.directory/plugins/dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy) / [`corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) | 把 WorkBuddy 的**模型**接进 DSH 模型选择器 + 账号池/积分 | 解决「用哪个模型」，不涉及把任务交给 WorkBuddy agent 执行 |
| [`ithtelab/workbuddy-manager`](https://github.com/ithtelab/workbuddy-manager) | WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 账号池 + OpenAI 兼容反代（`workbuddy2api`） | 网关与账号运维，不是 agent 委派 |
| 腾讯官方 [无头模式文档](https://www.workbuddy.ai/docs/zh/cli/headless) | `-p` / `--output-format` / `--resume` 等 CLI 用法 | 只用 CLI，无派发台账、无终态机、无会话归档 |
| [`ksoulness/dsh-codex-kit`](https://github.com/ksoulness/dsh-codex-kit) | Codex → DSH 的委派（本仓库的结构参照） | 方向相反：本仓库是 DSH → WorkBuddy |

- `permissionMode: plan` 与拒绝写工具是**给模型的声明**，不是进程级沙箱：CLI 仍以自己的权限运行，Bash 之类的工具能做什么由它自己的策略决定。
- 派发内容是「任务描述」，不是源码：只说工作区、范围、授权、验收标准，让 WorkBuddy 自己去读文件。
- 不读取、不打印、不落盘任何 token / cookie / API key；`models.json` 只取 `id`、`vendor` 这类身份字段。
- 归档在会话仍活跃、或本工具包没有该会话的终态记录、或目标文件已存在时会**拒绝**并给出原因，不伪造 `archived:true`。
- 本包不是腾讯 / DeepSeek 官方产品。
制作机（Windows、Node `v24.19.0`、WorkBuddy `5.8.3`、CLI `2.161.0`、DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`）实测：

- ✅ 真实只读派发 → `succeeded` / `end_turn` / 3 次工具调用 / 22.5s，`assistantText` 与工作区文件一致；
- ✅ 真实实施派发 → `succeeded` / `end_turn`，工作区里确实多出 `hello.txt`，内容与任务要求逐字一致（`DWB-RUN-OK`）；
- ✅ 真实归档两次：`archived:true`，15124 / 7973 字节，`sha256:a0c6cc74…` / `9887ba08…`；
- ✅ `wb_doctor` 正确识别安装路径、自带 Node、`liteBundleOnly`、自定义模型；
- ✅ `node --test` 65/65：流解析、工程名映射、schema 子集、MCP 握手、归档的全部拒绝分支、调度器只读读取（含软删除与失败码）、git 侧改动证据、发布/撤销/默认发布；
- ✅ MCP stdio 真实握手（`initialize` + `tools/list`）；
- ✅ 在真实 cordis 里挂载插件（`inject: ['tools', 'workingDirectory']`）→ 18 个工具全部通过 `dsh-tools` 自己的 `assertObjectJsonSchema` / `assertSupportedJsonSchema` 校验（`npm run verify`）；
- ✅ 委派真实产出：WorkBuddy 按任务在 `E:\Code\demo` 写出 `CHEATSHEET.md`，其中 5 条命令逐字核对全部命中源文档（`README.md:71/72/85/94/95`）；另一次运行由 `workspaceChanges` 抓到新增 `demo-workspace-change.md`（`addedCount: 1`）；

**English** · [中文](README.md)

> **DeepSeek Harness decides and verifies; the local Tencent WorkBuddy does the work.** Dispatch one bounded task, wait for a terminal state, check the evidence yourself, and the conversation shows up in the WorkBuddy desktop app under the same workspace.

A local kit that closes the loop between "DSH plans" and "WorkBuddy executes". Two front doors, one tool table:

- **Native DSH tool** (Cordis plugin `dsh-workbuddy-kit`, registers `wb_*` on `ctx.tools`)
- **stdio MCP server** (`dsh-workbuddy-mcp`, usable from any MCP client)

Both behave identically because they call the same `src/tools.mjs`.
Four shapes, one shared src/tools.mjs, so behaviour is identical; what differs is **who consumes it** and **how it is installed**:

| Shape | Files | Install | What it gives you | Restart needed? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **DSH plugin** (the main artifact) | plugin/index.mjs + cordis.patch.yml | dsh plugin --profile <profile> add . | Registers the 18 wb_* tools on ctx.tools, callable from DSH | **Yes** — the tool table is snapshotted at boot |
| **Skill** (bundled, optional) | skills/delegate-to-workbuddy/SKILL.md | copy into <DSH_HOME>/agents-home/skills/ | Tells the agent when to delegate, how to wait for a terminal state, how to check the evidence, how to archive by exact id | No — hot-loaded |
| **MCP stdio server** | mcp/server.mjs | add to any MCP client config | Same tools for non-DSH clients (Claude, Codex, your own) | No |
| **CLI** |  in/wb.mjs | 
ode bin/wb.mjs … or 
pm i -g | Manual checks and scripting, no client at all | No |

**The plugin is capability (tools); the skill is conduct (when and in what order to use them).** The plugin stands alone; the skill is meaningless without it. Install the plugin if you only want tools; add the skill when you want the agent to follow the dispatch → wait → verify → archive discipline by itself.

| Without it | With it |
| --- | --- |
| To get WorkBuddy working you retype context, paths and acceptance criteria, then babysit the run | One dispatch returns a `runId`; `wait_run` blocks to a terminal state; `state` / `stopReason` / `toolCalls` / `workspaceChanges` are structured, and a timeout is not a terminal state |
| "It said it's done" counts as done? | Tools return **evidence**: git before/after comparison, tool-call counts, the full transcript, a sha256 archive copy — the caller still has to check |
| The dispatched conversation is invisible in the desktop app, so it may as well not have happened | Registered in the app index by default, under the **same workspace** (it follows the DSH working directory); clicking it opens the real conversation |
| Monitoring the desktop scheduler means opening tasks one by one | Three read-only tools over `workbuddy.db`: task list, per-run history, success rate and failure codes, overdue tasks |
| Its permission boundary is guesswork | A measured matrix in the docs: in-workspace read/write needs `acceptEdits`; cross-directory reads and `WebFetch`/`curl` need `bypassPermissions`; `WebSearch` is unavailable headless |

The WorkBuddy desktop app (Tencent, measured `5.8.3`) ships its own CodeBuddy agent CLI:

```text
D:\Program Files\WorkBuddy\resources\app.asar.unpacked\cli\
  bin\codebuddy                  # @genie/agent-cli entry (measured 2.161.0)
  dist\codebuddy-lite-wb.mjs     # current build only ships the lite-wb bundle
```
That CLI runs headless (`-p/--print`, `--output-format stream-json`, `--session-id`, `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--max-turns`, `--effort`, …). This kit turns that channel into verifiable tools.

```text
you  ❯ let WorkBuddy read PROJECT.md and quote its first section

DSH  ❯ wb_start_run { task: "...", maxTurns: 6 }      → runId, sessionId, pid, workspace
     ❯ wb_wait_run  { runId }                        → state:"succeeded", stopReason:"end_turn"

The session is now in the desktop app's sidebar, in the same workspace, with the whole exchange — including WorkBuddy's own tool calls.

readme.section: A. Hand it to an AI (recommended, zero manual steps)
readme.text:
1. Preflight: node -v must be >= 22.19; git and dsh must exist; confirm the WorkBuddy CLI directory
   exists (Windows: C:\Program Files\WorkBuddy\resources\app.asar.unpacked\cli\bin).
2. Install: git clone the repo, then `dsh plugin --profile <my-profile> add .`,
   then confirm the dsh-workbuddy-kit row appears in `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config`.
3. Verify: `npm test` (expect pass 65 / fail 0), `npm run verify` (expect 18 tools / 0 failures),
   `node bin/wb.mjs doctor` (expect found true).
4. Report: a table of each command, the real output and a verdict; end by telling me whether DSH
   needs a restart.

readme.section: A. Hand it to an AI (recommended, zero manual steps)
readme.text:
Rules: no privilege escalation, no sudo, do not write workbuddy.db, do not modify my models.json or
session files, do not call wb_publish_session, and never claim success you have not observed. Paste the
raw error when something fails.
``

After installing, **restart DSH** (the tool table is snapshotted at boot). Skills are hot-loaded.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ksoulness/dsh-workbuddy-kit
cd dsh-workbuddy-kit
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .
npm run verify        # 18/18 registration contract against the DSH you actually run

Then restart DSH — tools are snapshotted at boot, so adding or removing one needs a restart.

readme.section: D. Offline tarball (no network, no npm install)
readme.text:
Every release ships dsh-workbuddy-kit-<version>.tgz containing  in/ mcp/ plugin/ src/ docs/ skills/ scripts/ LICENSE README*:

`sh
npm pack                                  # or download it from the release
npm i -g ./dsh-workbuddy-kit-0.1.0.tgz    # installs the dwb and dsh-workbuddy-mcp commands
dwb doctor
`

No global install needed either: unpack it and run 
ode package/bin/wb.mjs doctor.

```sh
node bin/wb.mjs doctor
node bin/wb.mjs run --task "read PROJECT.md and quote its first section" --wait 300
```

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `wb_doctor` | Read-only self-check: CLI, bundled Node, data directory, versions, custom models, recent auth walls |
| `wb_list_capabilities` | Real permission modes and custom model ids for a dispatch |
| `wb_list_projects` / `wb_list_sessions` | WorkBuddy project directories and the session transcripts on disk |
| `wb_start_run` | Dispatch an implementation task in a fresh session; `workspace` defaults to the DSH session directory |
| `wb_start_review` | Dispatch a read-only review (permission mode `plan`, `Write`/`Edit`/`NotebookEdit` denied) |
| `wb_wait_run` / `wb_get_run` | Wait for, or read, one run; `workspaceChanges` gives git-side evidence |
| `wb_cancel_run` | Cancel and terminate the whole child process tree |
| `wb_list_runs` | Recent dispatches recorded by this kit |
| `wb_read_session` | Read one transcript (messages, tool calls, model) |
| `wb_archive_session` | Digest-stamped copy of exactly one session transcript |
| `wb_list_automations` | Desktop scheduler tasks (status, soft-delete flag, schedule, next run, last outcome) |
| `wb_get_automation_runs` | Run history of one scheduled task, with failure codes |
| `wb_automation

1. The release only ships the `lite-wb` bundle → `CODEBUDDY_FORCE_LITE_WB_BUNDLE=1` is required.
2. The headless CLI cannot use the desktop login → the account-default model hits `Authentication required`; a custom model from `models.json` is used instead.
3. `state: succeeded` only means the process ended cleanly, so every run carries `workspaceChanges` (git porcelain before/after), tool-call counts and the transcript. Git-ignored paths are invisible to that check — read the file instead.
4. The desktop sidebar reads `workbuddy.db` (`transport='local'`, `deleted_at IS NULL`, `user_id` match). A CLI transcript without that row is **never** listed — that is why `wb_publish_session` exists, and why it is reversible.
5. Workspace grouping comes from the session's `cwd`, so dispatches follow the DSH session directory (verified by changing directories and re-dispatching). Publishing is the only vendor-state write in the whole kit: two rows, logged, undoable.
6. Scheduler access is read-only. Pausing or editing a scheduled task belongs to the app's own IPC/UI.

- ✅ `node --test` 65/65: stream parsing, project-slug mapping, schema subset, MCP handshake, every archive refusal branch, read-only scheduler (soft delete, failure codes), git evidence, publish/unpublish/default-publish
- ✅ 18/18 tool registration contract against the real `dsh-tools` schemas (`npm run verify`)
- ✅ Real dispatches, both read-only and implementing, with the produced files checked by hand
- ✅ Sessions published into the desktop app index and confirmed in its sidebar
- ⚠️ Only the lite bundle was available to test; other WorkBuddy builds are untested
- ⚠️ Cross-directory reads and web fetching are blocked under `acceptEdits`; the workarounds above are the measured ones, not guarantees
